text: What is Dandori Academy? Pikmin 4's new Switch 2 mode. Dandori Academy is a new challenge mode in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy, out Nov. 12, 2026. It adds 72 "Dandori exam" stages that test how efficiently you command your Pikmin, with three difficulty levels, medals and online leaderboards.. Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy launches Nov. 12, 2026.. "Dandori" is the Pikmin series' word for planning and multitasking, which Nintendo describes as "the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively." Dandori Academy turns that into a series of exams. Gematsu reported that the 72 stages vary in difficulty, earn players in-game medals, and "will be released over time." Nintendo Wire reported that new exams arrive every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and that online leaderboards let players compare scores with friends and strangers. The Switch 2 Edition also lets players challenge friends in Dandori Battles on the same system, or through GameShare locally or online via GameChat, even if the friend doesn't own the game. Players can give voice commands to Oatchi, the player's dog companion, through the Switch 2 microphone, and the game runs with sharper, higher-resolution visuals in TV and handheld modes. Yoshiaki Koizumi announced the edition in a Nintendo Direct on Sept. 9, 2026. Owners of the original Switch version can buy a digital upgrade, as with earlier Switch 2 Editions, and a new cartridge contains everything.

What is the Bearista cup? Starbucks' mystery bear cups, explained. The Bearista is Starbucks' bear-shaped glass cold cup: a bear in a winter cap, in Starbucks green, with the cap as the lid. It sold out within hours in November 2025. For 2026, Starbucks is selling mystery "Surprise Box" Bearistas starting Nov. 10, and the original Bearista returns to select U.S. Stores on Dec. 1, while supplies last.. Starbucks' mystery Bearista Surprise Boxes go on sale Nov. 10, 2026, a year after the original cup sold out in hours.. The first Bearista Glass Cold Cup, a 20-ounce glass cup shaped like a bear in a winter cap, in Starbucks' signature green, went on sale on Nov. 6, 2025, for $29.95, Quartz reported. It sold out within hours, some stores got only one or two, and resale listings on eBay and Mercari ranged from $150 to more than $1,000. Starbucks apologized, saying "excitement for our merchandise exceeded even our biggest expectations." On Oct. 26, 2026, Starbucks said the Bearista was coming back with a twist. The Surprise Box Edition goes on sale Nov. 10 in limited quantities: each box holds a mystery glass Bearista, and buyers find out which design they got only when they open it. The original Bearista returns to select U.S. Coffeehouses on Dec. 1. Reports did not list 2026 prices or purchase limits. The cups are part of Starbucks' holiday season lineup. Red Cup Day, when customers get a free reusable cup with an eligible handcrafted holiday drink, is Nov. 17, 2026, the same day a Winter Wonderland drinkware collection launches.
